Main Character
Create a customizable young adventurer.
Customization options:
Different outfits
Hairstyles
Accessories
Character names
Different visual themes
Krishna & Mythological Characters
Include respectful, non-combat-focused appearances of Lord Krishna and other mythological characters as important story characters, guides, or quest-givers.
Do not portray sacred characters in disrespectful, comedic, or inappropriate situations.
Game Mechanics
Add:
Walking/running exploration
Swimming
Climbing where appropriate
Puzzle interaction
Dialogue choices
Inventory system
Map
Quest tracker
Collectibles
XP and rewards
Visual Style
Use a cinematic Indian historical-fantasy aesthetic:
Golden sunsets
Blue ocean
Ancient sandstone architecture
Detailed temples and palaces
Traditional Indian artistic elements
Beautiful lighting
Realistic but respectful environments
High-quality character animations
Music & Sound
Use:
Peaceful Indian classical-inspired background music
Temple bells
Ocean and environmental sounds
Subtle ambient effects
Different music for exploration and important story moments
UI
Create a clean mobile-friendly interface with: Map | Quests | Inventory | Character | Achievements
Use elegant gold, blue, and purple accents while keeping text highly readable.
Game Progression
Structure the game into chapters:
Chapter 1 — The Arrival
Discover the city and learn the basics.
Chapter 2 — Secrets of Dwarka
Explore hidden locations and solve ancient puzzles.
Chapter 3 — The Lost Create a mobile game called “Dwarkadhish”, inspired by the ancient city of Dwarka and Indian mythology.
Game Concept
Create an adventure and exploration game where the player enters a beautifully designed ancient-world setting inspired by Dwarka. The game should focus on exploration, puzzles, quests, strategy, and mythology rather than realistic violence.
Story
The player begins their journey in the legendary city of Dwarka. They must explore different locations, complete quests, solve ancient puzzles, collect important objects, and learn about the stories and traditions connected with the city.
The game should have an engaging storyline divided into multiple chapters.
Gameplay
Include:
Open-world or semi-open-world exploration
Story-based missions
Ancient puzzles and riddles
Treasure/object collection
NPC characters with dialogues
Side quests
Hidden locations
Daily challenges
Achievement system
XP and level progression
Unlockable locations and items
Locations
Design beautiful environments inspired by:
Ancient Dwarka city
Royal palace
Temple complex
Seashore
Markets
Gardens
Ancient pathways
Underwater ruins
Caves and secret chambers
